info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fraud Detection Model API
info.description: The Fraud Detection Model API provides access to advanced analytics models designed to identify and mitigate fraudulent activities in banking transactions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve specific fraud model details based on unique identifiers. Financial institutions and risk management professionals frequently utilize this API to make data-driven decisions and enhance security measures. By leveraging predictive insights from the fraud models, organizations can significantly reduce potential losses and improve compliance with regulatory requirements.

get.summary: Retrieve the details of a specific fraud model.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a fraud model identified by its unique resource ID. It provides comprehensive information on the model's parameters, status, and performance metrics, enabling informed decisions for fraud detection strategies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details about the fraud model with ID RES-100045. Ensure that the request contains all required parameters in the specified format to successfully fetch the model information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested fraud model data.

riskScore.description: The calculated risk score for the transaction.
